name: Parks Concessions
description:
This dataset records concessions operating on New York City park properties, covering restaurants, golf courses, marinas, snack bars, gas stations, pushcarts, flower sales, and similar businesses. Each row represents a concession contract or permit tied to a specific park property, with 58 fields spanning property and unit identifiers, operator names and status, contract and permit codes, addresses and boroughs, and detailed financial terms.

Key fields include monthly minimum fee amounts for January through December, annual minimum fee schedules across up to five years, permit or license fees, security deposit requirements, percentage-fee flags, and late-payment terms. Dates cover permit or license start and end, move-in, contract signing and expiration, and original contract expiration. Several fields capture administrative details such as letter-of-credit references, capital work requirements, contract status notes, and due dates. A geometry type field indicates whether a property is represented as a polygon, point, or has no geometry.

The data supports analysis of concession revenue
